label: A two-maxima interpretation separates 'every maximum in being is GOD_2' from reduced naming
paraphrase: Closed mathematical control: on two beings, both in act as to being, with nothing more a being than anything, no causing and nothing GOD_2, both beings are maximal in being, so no maximum is unique (the causing condition also fails); the reduced nominal description holds vacuously and 'every maximum in being is GOD_2' fails. A statement about this finite interpretation only, not a claim that there are two maxima in being.
